description: Generate a game-ready 3D model (GLB) from a text prompt (async). Returns an asset { id }; call wait_for_asset (or poll get_asset) until taskStatus=2 and read files.model (GLB URL). Costs credits — see list_models(category='3d'). Omit `engine` for the default.

engine.description: engine name from list_models(category='3d') — the text-to-3D catalog

name: generate_3d_from_text
